title: [Nekomoe kissaten&VCB-Studio] Skirt no Naka wa Kedamono Deshita. / スカートの中はケダモノでした。 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
description:
![Skirt_Kedamono_1_800.webp](https://img.2222.moe/images/2022/11/26/Skirt_Kedamono_1_800.webp)
  
裙子里面是野兽。 / Skirt no Naka wa Kedamono Deshita. / スカートの中はケダモノでした。 BDRip
10-bit 1080p HEVC + FLAC，MKV 格式。每话约 140 MB。
10-bit 1080p HEVC + FLAC, MKV format. ~ 140 MB / EP.

这个项目与 **喵萌奶茶屋** 合作，感谢他们精心制作的字幕。
This project is in cooperation with **Nekomoe kissaten**. Thanks to them for elaborating Chinese subtitles.

原盘画质一般。原生分辨率为 864p，采用的算法比较柔和，使得线条只有轻微的锯齿和振铃，我们使用了逆向拉伸重构以修复这些问题。一些分镜有非常严重的编码瑕疵，猜测是制作时出了什么问题，我们使用了神经网络算法针对性地对这些分镜进行了处理，具体可看第四组对比图。由于制作比较混乱，原盘的噪点观感时好时坏，暗场还有较严重的色带。我们进行了较大力度的去色带处理，并用观感更好的噪点以替换掉原盘的噪点层。最后我们对纹理进行了轻微的补偿性锐化。
The source is average, produced in native 864p. Thanks to the gentle upscaling algorithm, lines only feature slight aliasing and ringing, which we fix directly by descaling and reconstruction. Some cuts come with serious compression artifacts, maybe something went wrong in production. We adopted a neural network algotirhm to targetedly fix these cuts (4th screenshots pair for reference). Due to the chaotic production, the noise has an inconsistent viewing experience, and there is also heavy colour banding in the dark areas. We performed aggresive de-banding and replaced the original noise with a better looking grains. In the end, we applied a slight compensatory sharpening to the textures.
